snippet.title: Please fix the mess | Reveal Trailer | Gamflix
snippet.description:
Clean up chaotic interiors, remove trash, repaint walls, and redecorate messy spaces, sometimes with a few suspiciously bodies lying around.

Minimum:
OS: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
Processor: 1.8 GHz or faster processor
Memory: 2 GB RAM
Graphics: Direct X 11.0 compatible video card

Recommended:
OS: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
Processor: 2.8 GHz or faster processor
Memory: 3 MB RAM
Graphics: Direct X 11.0 compatible video card
